# Rune Tech

> Rune Tech builds focused, single-purpose software — APIs and utilities cut clean enough
> to trust on day one. No sprawl, no bloat: each product does one thing, built to outlast
> the trend that inspired it. Built and run by one person, Jean-Eric Espiegle.

## Products

- [PDF Toolkit API](https://pdf-toolkit-api.fly.dev): Merge, split, compress, and rasterize
  PDFs behind one clean REST API. Free tier is 100 operations/month, no card required.
  Paid tiers: Starter $9/mo (2,000 ops), Pro $29/mo (10,000 ops), Scale $99/mo (50,000
  ops); overage on any paid tier bills at $0.002/operation.
- [Image Optimization API](https://image-optimization-api.fly.dev): Resize, convert,
  compress, and smart-crop images behind one clean REST API. Free tier is 100MB
  processed/month, no card required. Paid tiers: Starter $9/mo (250MB), Pro $29/mo
  (500MB), VIP $99/mo (unlimited); Starter and Pro bill overage at $0.01/MB.
